items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Alice Young. Those three, we were close.

ctx.x: Do you remember some of the people besides Minnie and Vi Redd?
Alice Young. Those three, we were close. I don’t think no other girls were in there at the time. And boys . . .
Were you the only trombone player?

items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Alice Young. Her name’s Mrs. H[?(inaudible)] or something now. But she – nobody else.

ctx.x: But at the Lincoln, some of the other kids went there with you, from the Melodic Dots?
Alice Young. Her name’s Mrs. H[?(inaudible)] or something now. But she – nobody else.
But there were – you said that when Bardu [Ali] thought you . . .
